question: Can one shared K=2 latent-conditioned policy compress the confirmed SAPPO V1 repertoire without destroying its complementary payoff structure or behavioral identity?

claim_boundary.fidelity: This is not PAPER-FAITHFUL latent discovery. The two latent meanings are assigned from frozen teachers and are therefore supervised.
claim_boundary.allowed_claim: A shared policy can or cannot preserve a previously confirmed two-policy repertoire under an explicit two-mode compression treatment.
forbidden_claims: the latent meanings were discovered label-free
a router learned to infer the opponent
the result generalizes beyond the frozen A/B poles
the result is deployment-valid under concealment

authorization_and_precedence.precedence_note: The older ladder required a separate R3 oracle-value pass before latent work. R3 was not run for the SAPPO terminals. The later frozen SAPPO protocol explicitly replaced that branch with direct K=2 authorization after a SAPPO crossover pass. This protocol follows the later ruling and does not claim that the older R3 gate passed.

student_architecture.actor: one shared decentralized actor pi_theta(a_i | o_i, z) with a learned z embedding
student_architecture.critic: one shared centralized scalar value critic conditioned on the same forced z
student_architecture.z_lifetime: assigned once at episode reset and held fixed through termination and auto-reset
student_architecture.opponent_identity_input: FORBIDDEN in actor, critic, and latent assignment
student_architecture.teacher_identity_input: FORBIDDEN; teacher selection is a fixed function of z only
student_architecture.initialization: fresh initialization; no averaging, merging, or warm-starting from either teacher
student_architecture.task_observation_action_reward: unchanged from the confirmed RULESET_V3_M1 SAPPO campaign

training_distribution.compute_parity: 2M shared-policy steps equals the explicit population's original 1M pi_A plus 1M pi_B budget
training_distribution.reason: Each latent receives 1M total interactions and 0.5M on each pole. Opponent identity remains hidden from the policy, and every update sees balanced poles and balanced latent assignments.

opponent_specs.A: OP6 plus the frozen min_alive_for_defender=2 genome overlay

required_live_assertions: resolved pole A profile has min_alive_for_defender=2
resolved pole B profile is canonical OP7 with no stale A overlay
each environment's z is unchanged for the full episode

single_training_intervention.name: online frozen-teacher action-distribution rehearsal
single_training_intervention.teacher_queries: At decision-eligible observations from the student's own rollouts, query pi_A when z=0 and pi_B when z=1 on the identical local observations and legal-action masks.
single_training_intervention.loss: Mean masked categorical KL(pi_teacher || pi_student(. | o,z)) across agents and action heads.
single_training_intervention.cadence: one teacher-rehearsal actor update after every four PPO actor minibatch updates
single_training_intervention.additional_losses: FORBIDDEN: no diversity, mutual-information, entropy-separation, contrastive, role, router, or opponent-classification objective
single_training_intervention.rationale: This reuses the confirmed SAPPO coefficient and cadence while changing only the supervised target from projected scripted actions to the frozen SAPPO policy distributions. It introduces one compression mechanism and no coefficient search.

ppo_and_checkpoint_contract.base_config: exact G0-V5/R1 PPO settings under RULESET_V3_M1, except for the K=2 architecture, the balanced forced-z cell assignment, the frozen-teacher rehearsal fields, artifact paths, run tag, seed, and 2M budget
ppo_and_checkpoint_contract.scored_checkpoint: the terminal checkpoint from the first completed rollout at or beyond 2,000,000 steps
ppo_and_checkpoint_contract.intermediate_checkpoints: diagnostic only and never eligible for scoring or selection
required_runtime_telemetry: teacher KL overall and by z
teacher argmax agreement overall and by z
PPO KL, value loss, explained variance, and entropy
static cell counts and realized steps per z/pole cell

training.purpose: single canonical training run plus all allowed environment/member offsets

development.purpose: preflight evaluator and telemetry validation plus non-gating health diagnostics

evaluation.purpose: single terminal forced-z payoff, retention, and behavioral-identity verdict

audit.reservation_record_exclusion: Future re-audits must exclude artifacts/strategic_demand/EXP2_K2_LATENT_COMPRESSION_PROTOCOL.json and docs/research-progress-tracker.md because both files reserve the blocks but do not use them.
audit.checks: declared seed contexts, broad integer scan, overlapping declared spans, and all-branch Git history with a positive control

terminal_evaluation.teacher_reference_role: paired compression baseline only; this is not a second SAPPO confirmation test

bootstrap.procedure: paired percentile bootstrap over seed-level episode outcomes

compression_retention_gate.teacher_matched_value: V_SAPPO = (WR(pi_A,A) + WR(pi_B,B)) / 2 on the same 8300001..8300192 seeds
compression_retention_gate.threshold_provenance: prospectively frozen as a 90% capacity-retention requirement before any K=2 implementation, training, development result, or evaluation result
compression_retention_gate.interpretation: Crossover without this non-inferiority-style retention result is mode separation, not successful compression of the explicit repertoire.

behavioral_identity_gate.matched_state_source: Pool every decision-eligible local observation recorded in the terminal evaluation block. Query z0, z1, pi_A, and pi_B counterfactually on each byte-identical observation and legal-action mask.
action_metrics: masked per-head Jensen-Shannon divergence in bits between z0 and z1
masked per-head argmax disagreement between z0 and z1
behavioral_identity_gate.pass: LCB95(JSD(z0,z1)) > 0 AND LCB95(teacher-A alignment margin) > 0 AND LCB95(teacher-B alignment margin) > 0
behavioral_identity_gate.bootstrap_unit: evaluation seed; all observations from one seed remain grouped

trajectory_telemetry_required.home_defense_fraction: fraction of decision ticks with at least one live non-carrier blue agent within 8 grid cells of the blue flag home
trajectory_telemetry_required.simultaneous_attackers: fraction of decision ticks with both live blue agents in the enemy half
trajectory_telemetry_required.enemy_half_occupancy: mean fraction of live blue agents in the enemy half over decision ticks
trajectory_telemetry_required.commitment_timing: first decision tick at which any live blue agent enters the enemy half; censored at episode length with a separate occurred flag
trajectory_telemetry_required.interception_behavior: fraction of eligible decision ticks with a live non-carrier blue agent interposed within 3 grid cells of the nearest-red-to-blue-carrier segment
trajectory_telemetry_required.flag_role_behavior: first enemy-flag contact, first pickup, pickup-to-capture duration, carrier fraction, capture count, and non-carrier screen fraction

behavioral_identity_gate.trajectory_reporting: Report per z, pole, and teacher with paired 95% intervals and signed z0-z1 effects. These features explain mode identity but cannot rescue a failed payoff, retention, or action-identity gate.

pass_requires: both primary payoff LCBs are positive
all three behavioral action-identity LCBs pass
all provenance and runtime invariants are valid
overall_verdict.if_passes: Freeze the terminal result and unlock Experiment 3 held-out A/B family generalization.
overall_verdict.if_fails: Stop the chain. Report whether the failure was payoff crossover, capacity retention, or behavioral identity. Do not proceed to held-out generalization or deployment realism.

forbidden_after_any_development_or_evalu: changing or extending the evaluation block
rerunning with a new seed because the result is unattractive
one_attempt_rule.invalid_run_exception: A run invalidated by a fail-fast provenance, plumbing, or runtime invariant may be discarded and relaunched from scratch with the identical frozen scientific configuration after the engineering fault is fixed. It is not scored and does not consume the scientific attempt.
one_attempt_rule.valid_fail: A valid run that misses any gate is the Experiment 2 result.

required_before_step_1: implement the frozen architecture and online teacher-KL path
add fail-fast tests for z persistence, 8/8/8/8 cells, teacher mapping, masks, opponent profiles, cadence, config diff, and seed bounds
produce a dry-run manifest with resolved configuration and all checkpoint/code hashes
verify the development and evaluation blocks remain untouched except for their reservation in this protocol
